title: UC OSPO Network: Outputs
text:
Lessons, software, talks, papers, and press from the UC OSPO Network. Each section lists the newest work first.
Every entry on this page comes from one BibTeX file, network-outputs.bib. Download it to cite these works in a paper or load them into a reference manager. Slides, handouts, and source for the talks are on the talks and workshops page.
